source.check: names read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1911: polled Wednesday 31 May 1911 in six divisions; the other fifteen were returned unopposed. Returned unopposed. Andrew Donnelly: no party label printed in 1911. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Montiaghs, 27 May 1908, listed as Nationalist: Newry Reporter, 2 May 1908, p. 10 ("Armagh County Council": the nominations); Montiaghs, 28 May 1914, listed as Nationalist: Portadown News, 2 May 1914, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Armagh County Council"); Newry Reporter, 28 April 1914, p. 5 ("Armagh County Council: Nominations")).
